In an attempt to take control of all ongoing events and solve the mysteries he's facing, Yehia turns to the "Blue Elephant" pills .

programme.title: Fadel We Neama
programme.desc: The events revolve around an Egyptian family going through financial trouble whose head decides to open a restaurant called Fadel & Neama, and he encounters many comic situations while managing the restaurant.

programme.title: Al-Dealer
programme.desc:
An old feud between Ali and Youssef leaves Youssef in jail in Egypt, and Ali emigrates to the Ukraine with his new wife and Youssef's ex-girlfriend, Samah.
Both men become prominent drug dealers and destiny brings them together again, but only one will make it out alive.

programme.title: Baed El Shar
programme.desc: The film follows Sully, who runs away from his wife, Farah, and finds himself stuck in a relationship with Maryam, and cannot marry her because of a magic spell, and he goes through a lot alongside his friend Meshmesh.

programme.title: Bani Adam
programme.desc: A thriller about the businessman Adam who faces criminal charges until the police enlist him for a critical mission. Will he deliver, or show an unexpected hidden side?

programme.title: Alerdhaljy fi qadiat nusb
programme.desc: When Samir graduates from college , he's confronted with the fact that his job will not provide him with enough income, so he decides to work in other jobs, and his fiancée struggles all the time until a producer asks her to work with him in advertisements.

programme.title: Bolteya El-A'iyma
programme.desc: Master Boltia is facing investors trying to control a private beach in the Max area in Alexandria, where she lives with her daughter, leading to a fierce confrontation between her and the investors.

programme.title: Bakhit & Adeela 2: Bucket & Pot
programme.desc: In this part of Lenin El-Ramly's Bekhit and Adila's movies, the couple Bekhit and Adila fall prey to the deceit of a gang of drug dealers who falsely promises to help them make it to the Parliamentary elections, but it turns out that the gang has a secret agenda.

programme.title: Syd aleatifi
programme.desc: A musical comedy telling the story of a mother who is trying to raise her son Sayyed after her husband's death. However, her son faces problems whether at college or with his uncle.

programme.title: Zenzana 7
programme.desc: As Harby serves his sentence in prison, the friendship he forms with Mansour survives their incarceration and release. As they manage to make a name for themselves in the crime world, one of their rivals drivers a wedge between them, leaving the two to clash.

programme.title: Bi Kams Arwah
programme.desc: Shams, nicknamed “the dead woman's son,” finds himself the only heir to an influential man, but the fortune is subject to an impossible condition: finding his four siblings, whose existence his father wiped out of records. programme.title: Al Yateem
programme.desc: It follows Arsan the Orphan, a boy who is left alone after his father is killed in a family struggle for inheritance. In a direct conflict with his uncle Hayel, the plot is intertwined with a strong emotional relationship and psychological events.

programme.title: Sumum Al Qayz
programme.desc: Taking place in the old Kuwaiti environment, it follows the problems of Abu Khalaf's family, especially his conflict with his nephew Oqab, who seeks to force Hilala to marry him despite her love for Munawar.
